findings.text: The only CI signal in the snapshot is a pull_request run on feat/control-room-rework; main has not run this rework yet.
The only evidence is a glob count over bin/, which proves the directory exists and not that the container is complete — the repository's own I5 says code proves existence, never completion.
The cited selector is the model's own status2 field for a person node, so the claim's only source is the assertion it is meant to prove.
The only evidence is a glob count of 24 files under lib/, which proves the directory exists and not that the engine is complete.
The only evidence is a glob count of 6 files under scripts/, which proves the directory exists and not that the gates are complete.
The only evidence is a glob count of 3 files under test/, which proves the directory exists and not that the suite is complete; no run of the suite is cited.

The stated reason is false on the cited file: nodes carry tabindex="0", role="button" and aria-label (line 701), Enter/Space is handled (line 947) and the help line names the keyboard (line 278) — the branch did not touch it because main already carries this since 8275057; only the unnamed <svg> root and the missing table twin still justify keeping #50 open.

The first clause is right — 0 of 9 PRD rows land on an issue — but the RTM view does not read "0 of 9 accounted for": deriveRtm returns accounted 9 of 9 (pct 100) because every row names a verification, which is what #54 itself says.

lib/viewer/c4-hologram.html:701 emits every node as role="button" with tabindex="0" and an aria-label, and the root <svg> at line 667 carries no aria-hidden or role="presentation" to prune them, so the map is announced as a set of named buttons inside a titled frame, not "as nothing at all" — the unnamed root and the missing table twin are real, but the sentence's conclusion is disproved by the same commit (8275057) its first clause cites, and #50 has not been updated since 2026-08-10, before that commit.
